newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Karachi bourse to recompose 100-share index.
newsitem.headline: Karachi bourse to recompose 100-share index.

text.p: The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said in a statement on Saturday that it would implement a recomposed 100-share index from July 1.
It said some listed firms had been reshuffled according to their value, market capitalisation and mergers.
"The recomposed index, based on the prices of April 30, 1997, will capture the market to the extent of 76 percent of the total market capitalisation," the statement said.
